newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown +5.12 pct vs mark/usd basket.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown +5.12 pct vs mark/usd basket.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 27.756 to the dollar after Wednesday's fixing at 27.712, and at 16.812 to the mark from 16.846.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +5.12 percent, up from +5.05 on Wednesday.
During the minute when the central bank calculated the fix, the crown was at +5.08 percent on the interbank market.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (1040 GMT) and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
